name: mirage
text: Bids don't come from the +EV bets list. They come from the engine's whole priced board: every game and prop it has a fair line for, whether or not anything on it is +EV to take right now. The bid desk checks each side against the bid rules (fair line fresh, enough books agreeing, game window, bet type). It then posts at the highest price that still leaves the edge floor (1.5% for proven types, 2.5% for riskier ones). So a side that isn't a +EV bet at Novig's current ask can still get a bid at a better price, and that is how bids work. More volume: the 'More, smaller bids' switch under the Bids slider is built for that. It posts 1/16-Kelly bids with a ceiling of 3,000 up at once and 250 new ones per pass, so thousands is already allowed. What actually limits the count is how many sides pass the rules and the new similar-bets cap ( per family, which v1.0.80 added). I can raise volume by loosening the books-agree count or the game window, or by lifting the similar-bets cap for bids, but each of those is a profit tradeoff. First I'll check how many bids are up now and which rule holds back the most, then loosen only what the data supports. Tell me if you'd rather I just lift the cap now.
